description: Reads a verified contract's ABI and flags owner-callable abuse functions: mint (dilute), pause (freeze exit), blacklist (block your wallet), setFee/setTax (tax you after entry), withdraw/sweep (pull funds), upgrade (swap logic). An unverified contract is itself a red flag. Diligence a price feed can't give.
name: contract_danger

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.

data.description: The result payload. Shape is service-specific; every field is documented in the tool description.
